title: Beer Braised Croatian Beef Stew
description: A hearty beef stew made with Croatian ingredients and a rich beer broth. Perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef on all sides, then remove from pot.
Add caraway seeds and flour to the pot, cook for 1 minute.
Add beer to the pot, scraping up any browned bits.
Return the beef to the pot, add broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley or thyme.
